Jamie (CSM): Heads up — MiraCare sent over their vendor security questionnaire. Main asks: SOC2 evidence (Type II), encryption-at-rest/KMS options, data residency, and a few DPA clauses. Need answers for onboarding kickoff on Mon. @Ravi can you confirm what we can share publicly vs what needs legal sign-off?
Ravi (Security): On it. We can share a SOC2 Type II summary and control list; full report needs NDA. For KMS: hosted default = Redwood-managed keys (AES-256); Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). Lina, are they using hosted or Private?
Lina (MiraCare-Sec): Hosted. They want confirmation we don't hold plaintext keys, that backups/snapshots are encrypted, and whether HSM integration is available.
Alex (DevEx): Quick clar: backups are encrypted with same key material; keys never stored in plaintext. For customer-managed KMS, keys stay in HSM. For hosted we use cloud KMS + envelope encryption; rotation quarterly. I'll paste a short blurb you can include.
Alex (DevEx): ```
Encryption at-rest: AES-256-GCM with envelope encryption via cloud KMS
Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS (customer data keys encrypted by cloud KMS)
Private: Customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS / GCP KMS with HSM-backed keys
Backups: snapshot encryption enabled, keys never stored in plaintext
Key rotation: quarterly (automated)
```
Ravi (Security): Also add: SOC2 scope excludes ephemeral debug logs and aggregated telemetry. We run quarterly vuln scans, pen-test annually, and have patch SLAs. For DPA clause redlines we need @Nora to sign off.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2024-11-09 13:02:45 completed on prod (no changes to encryption config).
Nora (Legal): I will review the DPA clause requests. Jamie, send me the specific paragraph they want redlined or I can provide our standard DPA + common exceptions.
Jamie (CSM): Thanks. Lina — we'll send a short redlined DPA and SOC2 summary by EOD Friday. Can you confirm the final stakeholder list for distribution? cc: @Lina
Lina (MiraCare-Sec): Stakeholders: lina@miracare.com (me), Ben (CTO), Aria (Compliance). Ben prefers email; Aria wants an SSO + audit log demo. We'll take the DPA + SOC2 summary + encryption blurb.
Alex (DevEx): :thumbsup: I'll assemble the SOC2 summary + encryption blurb and drop a Google doc for review. Link (placeholder): https://drive.google.com/miracare-soc2-summary
Jamie (CSM): Perfect. Ravi / Nora — please add your bullets to the doc by 3pm tomorrow. If legal needs a quick call with MiraCare, I'll schedule.
Lina (MiraCare-Sec): Thanks all — looking forward to the doc. If you can call out any residual risks for hosted mode (e.g., shared key management), that helps our reviewers.
